title: PainPath
subtitle: Mixed reality pain reporting
line: Patients map their pain on a life-size 3D body with hand tracking, then send the report to their specialist. XRCC 2026 finalist.
meta: Unity · C# · Meta Quest · hand tracking
desc: A mixed reality app that lets patients show their pain instead of describing it. Using hand tracking on a headset, you place markers directly on a life-size 3D body, tag each one with a pain type and an intensity from mild to severe, then review and submit the result for your specialist to see before your appointment. Finalist at the XR Creator Challenge 2026.
details: Hand-tracked marker placement directly on a life-size 3D body model
Pain type selection (ache, stiff, sharp) with a ten-step intensity palette
Rotate, undo and multi-area flows so patients can map complex pain accurately
A final review step summarises the report before it is submitted to the specialist
challenge: Pain is notoriously hard to communicate in words, and short consultations leave little time to unpack it. The interface had to be usable by patients with no XR experience, possibly in pain while using it.
solution: Kept every interaction to a single pinch or touch, anchored the UI to the room, and mirrored the clinical pain-scale language clinicians already use so the output slots straight into their workflow.

title: TicTacToe
subtitle: Hand-tracked WebXR game
line: Tic-tac-toe on a board anchored in your room, played by pinching. Runs from a browser link on a headset, nothing to install.
desc: A spatial take on tic-tac-toe built with the Immersive Web SDK (IWSDK), played with your hands on a board that sits in your room. It runs straight from the browser on a headset, so there is nothing to install and nothing to sideload.
details: Built with the Immersive Web SDK (IWSDK) and delivered entirely through WebXR
Hand tracking lets players place their mark by pinching, with no controllers needed
The board is anchored in the room so players can move around it as they play
Runs from a browser link, removing the install step that usually blocks quick demos

title: ARAsteroids
subtitle: Augmented reality arcade game
line: Asteroids rebuilt in AR: rocks spawn on real surfaces and you shoot them out of your room. Also the basis of an MSc study on immersion.
desc: An augmented reality reimagining of the classic arcade shooter. Asteroids materialise in your real-world environment and you have to blast them out of existence. Built as a native mobile AR experience, the game merges physical space with interactive gameplay, and served as the basis for MSc research comparing immersion in screen-based and AR versions of the same title.
details: World-tracked AR gameplay anchors asteroids to real surfaces using plane detection
Players shoot and destroy asteroids that appear and move through their physical space
Real-time physics simulation for asteroid fragmentation and debris
Progressive difficulty system with combo multipliers and score tracking
Comparative user study on immersion, delivered as an MSc dissertation awarded Distinction
challenge: Grounding fast-paced arcade gameplay in the real world. Asteroid trajectories needed to feel physically plausible while remaining fun and readable against any real-world background.
solution: Used plane detection and environment understanding to anchor gameplay to real surfaces, and designed high-contrast visual effects that remain legible regardless of background complexity.

title: Snap Lenses
subtitle: AR filter collection
line: Custom Snap AR lenses, from face effects to the full ARAsteroids game rebuilt inside the Snapchat camera. 121K+ views.
meta: Lens Studio · face and world tracking
desc: A collection of custom Snap AR lenses that have accumulated over 121K views, blending playful interactivity and immersive face effects with brand storytelling.
details: Designed and published multiple AR face and world lenses on Snapchat
Accumulated over 121K views across the lens collection
ARAsteroids lens brings the arcade game experience directly inside the Snapchat camera
Face tracking, segmentation, world tracking and particle effects
challenge: Balancing visual complexity with the performance constraints of mobile devices while making the effects feel natural and engaging.
solution: Optimised shaders and efficient particle systems that run smoothly across devices, including the ARAsteroids gameplay mechanics rebuilt natively in Lens Studio.

title: VR Ludo
subtitle: Virtual reality board game
line: The classic board game in a shared VR space for 2 to 4 players, with hands or controllers. In development.
desc: A fully immersive virtual reality adaptation of the classic board game Ludo, bringing friends together in a shared 3D space.
details: Multiplayer VR board game supporting 2 to 4 players
Immersive 3D environment with animated game pieces and dice
Hand tracking and controller support for intuitive interaction
Spatial audio and ambient environments for an engaging experience
challenge: Creating intuitive controls for VR that feel natural while keeping the social essence of the original board game.
solution: Gesture-based interactions and spatial audio that create a sense of presence and connection between players.

title: RateCardly design system
subtitle: Product design, sole designer
line: Built the design system, tokens and illustration style for a SaaS rate-card platform as the only designer on the team.
desc: Sole design lead for a SaaS product, owning end-to-end product design, UI, the design system and the component patterns the platform is built on.
details: Built the design system from scratch: reusable UI components, typography and colour tokens, and documented usage rules
Designed core product interfaces and interaction patterns, working directly with development on implementation
Design token and component library adopted across product, marketing and brand
Supporting illustration system: flat geometric forms, human figures with natural movement, bold colour blocking with a signature yellow accent
